\section[canta]{\ml{ചന്ത} (canta) — a market}

\label{lesson:ML-C135-market}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a spoon, then the Malayalam for a plate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ചന്ത}}
\textbf{\ml{ചന്ത}} (\emph{canta}) — \textquotedblleft{}a market\textquotedblright{}, where \textbf{\ml{മീൻ}} and \textbf{\ml{പച്ചക്കറി}} are sold.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Where the shopping happens.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{canta}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{canta}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} ask \emph{canta evide?}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a spoon, then the Malayalam for a plate, then say \emph{canta} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ചന്ത} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A market\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
